questions.question: Which is the highest dam in India, and across which river is it constructed?
options: Sardar Sarovar Dam across Narmada River
questions.explanation: Tehri Dam in Uttarakhand is the highest dam in India (height 260.5 metres), built across the Bhagirathi River in Garhwal Himalayas.

questions.question: Which is the longest earthen dam in India and the world?
questions.explanation: Hirakud Dam across the Mahanadi River in Sambalpur, Odisha is the longest earthen dam in India (main section 4.8 km; total length with dykes 25.8 km).

questions.question: Which was the first multipurpose river valley project developed in independent India (1948), modeled on the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) of the USA?
questions.explanation: Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC) established in 1948 was the first multipurpose river valley project in independent India, modeled after the US Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA).

questions.question:
Match the following famous dams with their respective rivers:
(A) Ukai Dam
(B) Matatilla Dam
(C) Mettur Dam
(D) Almatti Dam

(I) Betwa
(II) Tapi
(III) Krishna
(IV) Cauvery
questions.explanation: Ukai Dam is on Tapi (Gujarat); Matatilla Dam is on Betwa (UP/MP); Mettur Dam (Stanley Reservoir) is on Cauvery (Tamil Nadu); Almatti Dam (Lal Bahadur Shastri Reservoir) is on Krishna (Karnataka).

questions.question: Which dam in Kerala is a double-curvature concrete arch dam constructed in a narrow gorge between the Kuravan and Kurathi granite hills?
questions.explanation: Idukki Dam on the Periyar River in Kerala is India's most famous double-curvature thin arch dam, built between the Kuravan and Kurathi hills with Canadian assistance.
